name: Fannan

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Primary container (M3). The brand colour: highlight stroke, active indicators, upgrade/hire/upload actions. Only ever sits BEHIND dark text (on-lime).

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: On primary container: text and icons on lime.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: M3 primary: filled buttons (the main action), links, selected controls. Tone 40 of the lime hue.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: M3 secondary container: tonal buttons, selected chips, the active item in navigation.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Text on secondary container.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: M3 tertiary container (warm, never blue): small accents, badges.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text on tertiary container.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: M3 on-surface: headlines, body text, icons.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: M3 surface-container-lowest: cards, inputs, sheets.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: M3 surface: the page ground.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: M3 surface-container: quiet surfaces, side areas, trays.

tokens.name: surface-high
tokens.usage: M3 surface-container-high: hovered tonal surfaces, chips.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: M3 outline-variant (light): hairlines and card outlines.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: M3 outline: outlined buttons and text fields.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and labels (6:1 on paper).

tokens.name: lime-ink
tokens.usage: Same as primary: when green must be text on white.

families.display: "Google Sans Flex", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.body: "Google Sans Flex", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The logo only. Always with the lime highlight behind "fannan".

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Your next job is looking for you.

styles.name: arabic-wordmark
styles.usage: The Arabic logo only, with the lime highlight.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Put your best work on one link, made for the studios and clients who hire.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small caps labels, tags, captions; letter-spacing 0.08em.

type.note: Google Sans Flex (OFL) for UI and headings; IBM Plex Sans Arabic for Arabic text and headings. The logo keeps Bricolage Grotesque 800 (Latin) and Marhey 700 (Arabic).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on small items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutters on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Space between blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: M3 small: chips, badges, small tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: M3 medium: inputs, menus, small cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: M3 extra-large: cards, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: M3 full: buttons, chips, toggles, navigation indicators.

highlight.note: The geometry of the chisel stroke behind the wordmark. Keep it identical everywhere.

tokens.name: hl-skew
tokens.usage: skewX of the stroke (mirror to +14deg for Arabic).

tokens.name: hl-rotate
tokens.usage: Slight tilt of the stroke (+1.5deg for Arabic).

tokens.name: hl-top
tokens.usage: Stroke starts at this height of the word box (the lower half of the letters).

tokens.name: hl-bottom
tokens.usage: Stroke ends this far above the bottom of the word box.

tokens.name: hl-overhang
tokens.usage: How far the stroke runs past the first letter; ~0.09em past the last.

system: Material 3 (Google), seeded from Fannan lime (round 4, stage C, decided by Ahmed: 'full Google look'). Colour roles follow M3 naming; the older names (ink, paper, mist, line, muted) map onto M3 roles so existing screens follow. Still no blue anywhere, and lime still only sits behind dark text.
